title: Understanding iloc
text: The iloc function is used to access a group of rows and columns by integer index. It uses the format iloc[row\_index, column\_index].

title: Accessing Elements with iloc
text: When using df.iloc[1, 2], you are trying to access the element in the second row and third column. Does the DataFrame have a third column?

title: Checking Column Index
text: How many columns does the DataFrame have?
